definitions: A sweet spread made by boiling fruit and sugar to a thick consistency.
A situation in which a large number of people or vehicles are close together and unable to move.
An instance of a machine or part becoming stuck or blocked.
An informal or difficult situation; a predicament.
An informal musical session where musicians improvise together.
examples: A paper jam in the printer.
I am in a bit of a jam.
The band had a late-night jam.
